notes.title: Labyrinth of Rage V. 0.5 Update Notes
notes.content:
- Added Stats information to Equipment page
- Re-designed levels
- Adjusted first boss stats (Grand Spider Demon King)
- Minor enemies now drop items

notes.title: Labyrinth of Rage V. 0.4 now available!
notes.content:
V. 0.4 now available:

Updates include:

- Level Re-Design
- New 2D Art
- New Soundtrack
- New Items
- Minor Updates to Post-Processing and UI

notes.title: V. 0.2.1 - Bug Patches
notes.content:
V. 0.2.1 Just released Sept. 3rd 2023.

Patches Included:

- Fixed bug in Main Menu where Tutorial level would not load.
- Removed Motion Blur from camera
- Minor UI Adjustment for in game HUD.

Future updates include Combat functionality, lighting settings, and additional enemies.
